verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a real-time JSON API that scrapes live Google and Google News results. Cached results expire after 1 hour, and the docs give a way to retrieve submitted searches later. That supports freshness, though it comes from live scraping rather than a maintained index. No date-range or recency filter parameter appears anywhere in the evidence; the documented operators are only inurl:, site: and intitle:. Missing for 10: documented date-range/recency filter parameters, explicit freshness guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of result freshness.
